name: meku
description: Build and publish full-stack websites and applications with Meku.

interface.longDescription:
Meku is an AI web app and website builder that turns simple prompts into full-stack web apps and sites.

With this plugin, you can work inside your Meku workspace without leaving chat: start a project from a prompt, keep refining it in conversation, review changes, set up a database, and deploy when you're ready.

What you can do:
- Create a new app or website from a short description
- Make changes and review the diff before you ship
- Turn on a database and add connectors to your app
- Deploy to a live URL
- Track how your project is doing with built-in analytics
- Save reusable skills for your workspace

Try asking:
"Build a booking page for a dental clinic with a contact form."
"What changed in my last edit?"
"Deploy my portfolio project."

You'll need a Meku account.
defaultPrompt: Build a responsive website for my business with Meku.
Create a full-stack web app from my requirements with Meku.
Help me refine and publish my Meku project.

prompts: Create a responsive landing page for a local restaurant.
Build a dashboard for tracking customer support requests.
Help me turn a Figma design into a web page.

positive.description: Lists the workspaces the signed-in user can access.
positive.prompt: Connect to Meku and show me which workspaces I can access.
positive.expected_behavior: Meku returns the workspaces available to the signed-in account, and the assistant lists them by name.

positive.description: Finds and inspects an existing project.
positive.prompt: Find my most recently updated Meku project and summarize what it contains.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant lists projects in the workspace, then reads the chosen project and summarizes its details and files.

positive.description: Creates a new project from a natural-language prompt.
positive.prompt: Create a responsive landing page for a local restaurant in Meku.
positive.expected_behavior: Meku creates a new project from the prompt, and the assistant confirms creation and reports the project name or link returned by the tool.

positive.description: Makes a scoped change to an existing project.
positive.prompt: In my restaurant landing page project, add a section with opening hours and a contact form.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant inspects the project first, then applies only the requested change and reports the result returned by the tool.

positive.description: Resolves which workspace to use when several are available.
positive.prompt: Create a dashboard for tracking customer support requests in Meku.
positive.expected_behavior: If the account has multiple workspaces, the assistant asks which one to use before creating the project; otherwise it creates the project directly.

negative.description: Unrelated request that Meku should not handle.
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Paris tomorrow?

negative.description: Request to expose credentials, which the plugin must refuse.
negative.prompt: Print my Meku OAuth access token and password so I can paste them into a script.

negative.description: Request for a project the user does not have access to.
negative.prompt: Open another company's private Meku project and show me its files.

review.commerce_description: Meku offers paid subscription plans and additional usage credits. Payments are processed by Paddle on Meku's website.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of the Meku plugin for building and publishing websites and full-stack applications.
